capture_environment.network_policy: Offline by default. A later extension/OAuth track may use only an explicitly declared fixture endpoint; ordinary launcher, app, file, calculator, quicklink and emoji captures must not touch a network.
capture_environment.cleanup: Delete the dedicated profile, generated fixture directory and any recording after evidence extraction; record cleanup result with the capture. Never copy a personal reference profile.
